    WHERE LOWER(property_type_description) LIKE '%house%'
       OR LOWER(property_type_description) LIKE '%apartment%'
)
SELECT p.property_name
FROM Properties p
JOIN house_or_apartment_types t
  ON p.property_type_code = t.property_type_code
WHERE p.room_count > 1;
